findings: APOB p.(Pro955Ser) variant shows reduced LDL internalization efficiency in hepatocytes
Dose-dependent effect observed: homozygous < heterozygous < wild-type
rationale: The variant demonstrates functional impairment consistent with FH pathogenesis via reduced LDL uptake, with quantitative evidence showing allele frequency difference between FH patients and general population
experimental_details: LDL internalization assay in hepatocytes measuring fluorescence intensity after 30-min incubation at 37°C, comparing homozygous/heterozygous p.(Pro955Ser) against wild-type and known pathogenic p.(Arg3527Gln) controls
